en.title: Design at a glance
en.description: FDAI flow for Design at a glance.
en.alt: Design at a glance. The main stages are Azure Policy DeployIfNotExists / (AMBA pattern) - fan-in as code, Activity Log + resource events, Per-cell Event Hubs (sharded), FDAI cell (scale unit) / event-ingest -> trust-router -> risk-gate -> executor, Audit ledger / append-only, hash-chained, never sampled, Telemetry plane / ADX / Log Analytics - tiered, sampled, rolled up, Index plane: ADX + Postgres + pgvector.

ko.title: 한눈에 보는 설계
ko.description: 한눈에 보는 설계에 대한 FDAI 흐름입니다.
ko.alt: 한눈에 보는 설계. 주요 단계는 Azure Policy DeployIfNotExists / (AMBA 패턴) - fan-in as code, Activity Log + resource events, 셀별 Event Hubs (샤딩), FDAI 셀 (scale unit) / event-ingest -> trust-router -> risk-gate -> executor, 감사 원장 / append-only, 해시체인, 절대 샘플링 안 함, 텔레메트리 평면 / ADX / Log Analytics - 티어·샘플·롤업, 인덱스 평면: ADX + Postgres + pgvector입니다.
